properties.Des: An erosion event leaves a large pile of debirs at the base of the cliff.
This is an area where you can clearly see the layering of the chalk geology as it is exposed along the cliff.
The location of The Old Battery, an area currently under The National Trust operation.
A clear change in the underlying geology, with the exposure of various mud and sand stones.
The erosion of the cliffs above at Alum Bay often leaves a number of fossils on the beach for tourists to find.
The New Battery was placed here after concerns about erosion at The Old Battery from heavy use.
This area of cliff perches over a large overhang of chalk, a key phase in the process of erosion at hard cliff sites.
The location of The Needles lighthouse, on the outermost of the three stacks that make up this famous landmark.
